sharedRules.name: Subservient Mercenaries
sharedRules.description: Pungari Threshers may be used in any fleet but always use Shaltari Fire Ships. When used in a Shaltari fleet, this Ship gains Shield-5+.

sharedRules.name: Advanced Artillery
sharedRules.description:
While on the Max Thrust or Silent Running Orders, this Ship may attack with its N-12 Artillery Cannon Turrets.
While on the Weapons Free Order, this Ship counts as having an additional weapon for its Detector rule.

sharedRules.name: Magellan Lifeboats
sharedRules.description: If this ship is destroyed with an Admiral assigned to it, you may transfer that Admiral to another friendly ship of H or C Tonnage with no Admiral within 18", losing the benefits of this ship's Command Ship rule.
